mapper.insert: insert into cart_item (cart_id, user_id, merchant_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, sku_name, image, price, number, create_time) values (#{cartId}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{skuName}, #{image}, #{price}, #{number}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update cart_item set number = #{number} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from cart_item where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select * from cart_item where cart_id = #{cartId} and product_id = #{productId} and (sku_id = #{skuId} or (sku_id is null and #{skuId} is null)) limit 1
select * from cart_item where cart_id = #{cartId} order by id
select * from cart_item where user_id = #{userId} order by merchant_id, id
select * from cart_item where user_id = #{userId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by id
